notes: «أبو كامل، فضيل بن حسين» is read as one name: no «و» or «ح» joins the two parts, so the comma is an appositive; if they are two co-transmitters the route set changes
«- يعني ابن زريع -» is an editor gloss and is left out
the last link is Abu Musa, whose words relay the Prophet's saying; the Prophet is the end of the chain
